es.title: Radón
es.extract: El radón es un elemento químico perteneciente al grupo de los gases nobles. En su forma gaseosa es incoloro, inodoro e insípido y en forma sólida su color es rojizo. En la tabla periódica tiene el número 86 y símbolo Rn.

en.title: Radon
en.extract: Radon is a chemical element; it has symbol Rn and atomic number 86. It is a radioactive noble gas and is colorless and odorless. Of the three naturally occurring radon isotopes, only 222Rn has a sufficiently long half-life for it to be released from the soil and rock where it is generated. Radon isotopes are the immediate decay products of radium isotopes.
